s15_projection_correction.was: the archaeological projection compared VALUES -- seed_roots, observation contents, spec strings
s15_projection_correction.defect: any two DISTINCT experiments differ in those values, so every mechanism scored class A trivially, including seed shopping which S14 had already shown leaves no fossil at all. The first run reported 8 class A / 0 class B, which contradicted the result that motivated the experiment.
s15_projection_correction.corrected: the projection is now STRUCTURAL -- counts of worlds, experiments, observations, events, event-type multiset, distinct spec hashes, work items. Observational equivalence asks whether the adversarial record is indistinguishable from SOME honest single-shot record, which is a question about form, not about which seed was drawn.
s15_projection_correction.lesson: this is the fifth instance in the campaign of comparing the wrong object. The signature this time was a result that contradicted an already-established finding -- S14 had proven seed shopping leaves no fossil, so any projection calling it class A was measuring something else.
